init_config_from_cli: initialize the Config parser from command line arguments with required data and logDir paths
init_config_from_file: initialize the Config parser by loading arguments from a config file path
init_config_known_args: initialize the Config parser and parse only known args ignoring unknown ones
configure_nerf_training_params: configure training parameters like epochs, learning rate, batch size, and loss functions
configure_raymarching_params: configure raymarching parameters including zNear, zFar, sample count, and sampler type
